recipes.title: Select the task’s organizing plane
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When the screen’s main perceptual task or allocation of scene/decision space is unresolved.
process: Name entry, spatial live action, board/graph decision, local inspection or result/recovery phase
Mark avatar/path/threat/aim/board and actual gaze route on a whole-screen reference
Choose scene-led peripheral groups, a concentrated decision plane, a split subject/detail view or UI-as-game full screen using the task and fit
output: SCREEN_PLAN with reading order, protected regions and chosen/rejected topology
test: Real camera envelope and named protected regions
Check full task flow separately from aesthetics
No important object or prompt covered
exception: A live tactical game can use a central overlay if it preserves the required world information; a deliberately calm cinematic selector can remain scene-dominant
For UI-as-game, the decision plane can fill the screen; a protected empty center is not mandatory.
avoid: One generic menu grid or global bottom bar for every genre
Inferring paused gameplay or touch form factor from a still image

recipes.title: Resolve a world-specific visual grammar
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When controls must belong to actual imagery or an existing coherent design.
process: Hold task, labels, state and background constant in a bounded variant/adaptation sheet
Resolve surface/edge/corner/light/texture/type/glyph relations, with ornament assigned to specific carriers
Choose quiet utility/tab/HUD and deliberate commitment families that share grammar without identical anatomy
output: ART_TASK_CONTRACT, actual visual tokens, variant decision and named structural axes
test: Compare representative commit, utility, choice, status and result in whole context
Inspect actual edge light, material density and type relationships
Require a reason for unexplained mixing rather than banning a material
Inspect family beside the actual scene at intended scale
Confirm command labels and status remain visually distinct
exception: An abstract overlay can intentionally differ from world materials; narrative devices, paper, glass, comic ink, ornate metal and plain surfaces are all valid when specified
A subjectless dense tool may not need a scene pane
Flat/dark/rounded materials are valid when coherent and readable
A brief requiring actual face/body or inner-layout change cannot pass with recoloring
Preserve an established coherent grammar; do not invent a new art direction for a bounded fix.
A deliberately loud arcade menu or diegetic terminal may need strong relief/glow; it still requires legible ink and justified hierarchy.
avoid: Copying world textures onto every label face
Equating coherent family with identical shapes or material depth

recipes.title: Compose entry through the first consequence
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When a player enters or resumes an actual session.
process: Storyboard actual entry, real prerequisites/setup, readiness/loading, first controllable frame, first consequence and supported return
For each transition name retained/replaced layers, focus/input owner and state/reset scope
Place only necessary first-action instruction by its object; preserve actual mode, room and pause semantics
output: FLOW_STORYBOARD and runtime first-input recording requirement
test: Record first input through first readable consequence
Inspect each stage for dead-looking empty states and competing hero panels
exception: Some games begin directly in play; do not add a menu or tutorial solely to satisfy the storyboard.

recipes.title: Reserve concurrent layer geometry and ownership
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When independent HUD/menu/prompt/chat/announcement layers can coexist.
process: Register visual, readable and hit bounds in one confirmed logical coordinate system
Give every allowed combination priority, input owner, lifetime, interruption and restoration rules
Reserve/reflow/compact/queue/replace lower-priority groups; preserve essential live hazards and the active route/subject region
output: LAYER_MATRIX, occupancy map, allowed combinations and dismiss/focus restoration contract
test: Restored layer returns to expected state
exception: A modal may intentionally conceal nonessential world content
Online/live danger cannot be hidden under an assumed pause
Observing occlusion is not proof of input leakage
Chat, narrative or social information may be the current main task; do not automatically shrink it merely because another panel opened.

recipes.title: Give illustrated surfaces a safe ink mask
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When art has rims, folds, corners, straps or a nonrectangular readable interior.
process: Separate art bounds, visible face and actual glyph/icon ink extents
Define a content-safe rectangle/mask excluding ornaments and transparent padding
Anchor title/close/list/footer inside it; clip or scroll before the decorative rim; retain scalable corner ownership
output: PANEL_ANATOMY and measured safe ink/list/footer bounds
test: Whole panel and native edge/corner crops with longest content and last visible row
Check ink does not cross ornament, footer or close control
Compare unloaded and loaded artwork geometry
exception: Intentional text-on-object composition is valid if the object provides a real readable text region; full-bleed artwork can work without a framed panel
avoid: Treating the bitmap rectangle as all usable text area
Removing decorative frames solely because plain panels are easier

recipes.title: Derive control length and silhouette from content
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When selecting or correcting command/navigation/selection control geometry.
process: Classify role then measure loaded longest labels, costs, timers and real icon/shortcut slots
Width = actual ink + present slots + real gaps + horizontal safe insets + chosen rim; height = supported line height + vertical breathing room + chosen rim/body allowance
For circles fit label/timer within the usable face chord; for comparable choices share width; preserve fixed shell/hit/siblings during internal press
output: CONTROL_CONTRACTS with target/silhouette/face/ink, width policy and supported state specimens
test: Shortest/longest real labels and every supported timer/cost/state value
Actual face/ink crop and hit-region trace
exception: A short text-only circle or long centered button can be correct; flat/no-body/no-icon controls are valid when the brief allows them
No icon/body is required unless role/context/brief needs it
Equal width fits comparable volume values or local binary choice; unrelated utilities need not be equal
A source rectangle does not establish its actual engine hitbox
avoid: Shrinking all labels to preserve a chosen circle
Counting decorative shadow as target size
Applying a source-image diameter as an engine minimum

recipes.title: Make local action rank and commitment legible
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When several actions compete within one task region.
process: Separate command rank, hazard, persistent selection, navigation and read-only meaning
Use adjacency, grouping, position, typography, containment and surface contrast together
Attach cost/probability/condition/consequence to the qualified action; retain quieter discoverable Back/Close
output: ROLE_FAMILY_MAP and exact local commitment/recovery contract
test: Whole panel reading order and local control crop
Required information stays readable at the decision
exception: Several independent task groups can each contain a primary; deliberate flat choices can use alignment and current-state markers
avoid: One primary across the whole game
Promoting every inspection/pagination action to the same visual weight
Adding confirm/cancel steps as styling

recipes.title: Declare material underlays and quiet reading zones
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When scene pixels remain visible through or beside a reading/control surface.
process: Name allowed bright/dark/busy camera underlays and quiet ink zones
Render real labels/state pairs against the strongest reached underlays
Choose local backing, opacity, placement, structure or type adjustment within material intent; keep reflection/texture out of ink
output: UNDERLAY_FIXTURES, surface/ink/state pairs and selected material policy
exception: Do not force every transparent UI opaque
No measured native contrast compliance can be inferred from uncalibrated JPEG stills
A deliberately light wallet may use a different coherent surface family

recipes.title: Place HUD against the real camera envelope
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When fixed live HUD sits over changing scenes/cameras.
process: Capture representative avatar/next landing/target/threat/recovery regions at actual camera states
Build an occlusion/background envelope before choosing anchors
Verify same boundary/type against sky, light objects, dark objects and busy textures; keep world warnings distinct from screen commands
output: HUD_ENVELOPE, protected corridor map and actual fit evidence requirement
test: Native control crop in every differing pairing
Actual task and input reach checks in a later implementation
exception: A centered HUD can be correct when that region is not needed for world decisions, or during a deliberate pause/result phase
avoid: Universal corner placement or HUD occupancy percentages
Treating one clear screenshot as proof of all-camera visibility

recipes.title: Allocate palette, detail and state channels
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When defining or reviewing palette across scene, HUD and menus.
process: Name surface/ink/command/current/focus/unavailable/feedback/hazard roles from real pairings
Spend chroma, contrast and detail where the task must notice; use spatial containment when multiple urgent signals coexist
Provide state meaning through text/check/shape as needed; do not turn a faction/world color into a universal UI reservation
output: ROLE_COLOR_TOKENS, ornament carrier map and state pairing specimens
test: Real background pairs, color-independent reading and supported state combinations
Unavailable reason and result remain visible
No selected glow is reported as actual completion
Priority remains identifiable without relying on hue alone
exception: A restrained monochrome system is valid with shape/text markers; bright or multi-accent games are valid if roles remain legible
Multiple simultaneous urgent signals may all be strong; containment and spatial relation then carry rank. Never globally reserve a game’s existing faction color for UI commands.
avoid: Universal green/yellow/red bans
Assuming the brightest existing button is automatically the required primary

recipes.title: Fit typography and glyph mass at actual scale
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When labels must work on a real material and reading surface.
process: Resolve font/license/fallback, weight/case/size/line-height/wrapping/numerals together
Inspect loaded real glyphs, counters, baseline and optical icon mass within the actual face
Use plain ink, bounded outline/shadow or local backing by surface; prefer family-level optical corrections over per-word hacks
output: TYPE_SPECIMENS using longest supported strings, mixed scripts, icons and value extremes
test: Mixed-script names, numerals, longest supported labels and actual font fallbacks
Smallest rendered crop against actual dark/light/busy surfaces
Actual small supported viewport and enlarged text
exception: Outlined text, plain text, decorative display type and no-icon controls are valid in their actual context
Display type is not forbidden for action labels; it must survive the actual string, language and size.
avoid: Inferring exact font or engine text size from an encoded image
Replacing every scene label with a card before testing the existing treatment

recipes.title: Make original art resize without distortion
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When an art frame must change width/height or locale without losing its structure.
input: Variable label length or responsive width
process: Mark fixed corners/caps/bolts, stretchable quiet centers and tileable texture zones
Keep live label/state/focus layers separate from background art
Implement native slicing or separate caps+center; derive minimum face from ink+insets, then inspect short/long widths
output: ASSET_STRETCH_MAP, geometry limits, provenance and render specimens
test: Longest real label at several widths
No rim/body distortion or text clipping
exception: Plain geometric controls can remain native/code-drawn; 9-slicing is unnecessary if there is nothing to preserve.

recipes.title: Align repeated decisions and real readiness
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When destinations/items/resources are compared repeatedly.
process: Group title -> current/required condition/value -> actual action as one scan unit
Choose simple segments, rows/table or subject-detail composition from comparison/identity/fit needs
Keep inspect/select/owned/equipped/unavailable/path-ready/commit distinct; derive available wording from confirmed domain/server predicates
output: DECISION_SLOT_CONTRACT, data predicates, scroll/selection retention and boundary fixtures
exception: No table/grid/cards are mandatory by genre
A green conditional instruction does not prove operational route readiness
Undiscovered empty model pane can correctly preserve discovery rules

recipes.title: Construct motion between actual static states
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When motion carries press, arrival, attention, selection, removal or result.
process: Name meaning, moving part, fixed shell/hit region, start/mid/end geometry and neighbor bounds
Resolve timings/easing as project trials; specify cancellation/rapid repetition/input handoff
Produce before/mid/settled specimen and runtime trace; reduced motion retains static meaning
output: MOTION_CONTRACT, settled/reduced states and runtime recording requirement
test: No accidental occlusion or hit-target instability
No animation-only success or selection meaning
exception: A hover scale can be valid if overlap and hit behavior are deliberately safe; the Flowlab example does not prove its hit region or timing.

recipes.title: Treat asset arrival and failure as real states
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When menu skin/item art can arrive after content or fail.
process: Reserve art and safe ink slots before optional pixels arrive
Keep identity/cost/count/action readable in deliberate fallback without target jumps
For essential art expose actual supported loading/failure/recovery; inspect same fixture before/after arrival
output: ASSET_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT and unloaded/loaded/failure fixtures
test: Same page/fixture unloaded, loaded and actual supported failure states
No jump in required label/target geometry
exception: An intentional layout change can be valid if it is specified, preserves state and is verified; optional decorative art need not produce an alert
avoid: Calling a blank thumbnail a completed asset test
Inventing an error state absent from the implementation
Measuring loading time from nonmatched screenshots

recipes.title: Refresh locale across visible and deferred controls
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When language changes within a live screen.
process: Separate semantic state from displayed strings and use one locale owner
Refresh visible/status and newly revealed subtrees from the same locale state
Exercise longest real labels; preserve selected values, scroll, gameplay and supported actions across refresh
output: LOCALE_FIXTURES, refresh ownership and deferred-row/result inspection sequence
test: Change locale with settings open, reveal deferred rows, toggle relevant state, close/reopen and revisit result
Check no unintended stale-language labels and no clipped required text
Actual input verification remains separate from static screenshot observation
exception: Explicit bilingual content or intentionally untranslated product names are valid; identify them rather than treating all mixed scripts as bugs
avoid: Changing game meaning to shorten a label
Declaring all localization verified because the top-level tabs changed

recipes.title: Explain actual outcome, recovery and useful copy
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When presenting end/recovery or deciding what copy is essential.
process: Promote actual outcome and attach practice/record/time eligibility to the qualified metric
Classify sentences as identity/rule/condition/consequence/recovery/duplicate/filler
Retain missing meaning and actual Retry/Back loss scope; remove duplicates and their obsolete fixed height
output: RESULT_CONTRACT, classified copy and return/reset map
test: Next action and return verified by actual input when authorized
First-action comprehension by a novice where applicable
exception: A lightweight nonmodal result can be sufficient; a cinematic result screen is valid if required qualifiers and recovery remain readable
Explicit pause, end, failure or onboarding text can look obvious to an expert but still prevent a frozen/broken-state misunderstanding.
avoid: Reporting practice completion as a whole-run record
Inferring dodge success, attack continuity or persistence from a still

recipes.title: Require matched craft and behavior evidence
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When delivering or accepting a guided implementation.
process: Freeze requested silhouette/length, face/rim/body, typography/glyph, internal layout, rank/state and scene relationships
Inspect matched whole screen first, then native control/state crops and motion; preserve before/intent/actually rendered ledger
Separate structure, parity, visual/input/device checks and user preference; fix missing required axes then recheck affected states
output: EVIDENCE_LEDGER, actual pass/fail/not_run/blocked/inconclusive gates and scoped user review
test: Every required structural axis has actual matching rendered evidence
Actual input/state regression plus protected-content check
Unknown calibration yields inconclusive comparison rather than invented equality
Clipping, hierarchy, optical baselines, texture/corner fidelity, scene fit
State combination, long text, aspect changes, reduced motion
All target relationships visible in the actual render
No new competing accent or texture noise
exception: A source-only draft may be useful if its rendered acceptance remains unresolved
A source-only proposal is allowed but must retain proposal status; a still cannot verify motion or hit behavior.
A changed art brief or newly discovered scene conflict justifies another iteration; satisfying a checklist does not prove that the user likes the result.
avoid: A color/font/background-only pass satisfying an explicitly requested face/body/layout change
Calling screenshot dimensions a phone test
Calling structural validation user approval

recipes.title: Map platform units and inputs explicitly
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When a core contract enters a specific engine or device.
process: Record logical units, viewport/safe-area/host chrome, input/focus routes and capture calibration separately
Apply actual platform target/semantic rules in their native units; never transfer screenshot px/CSS px/pt/dp as equal
Verify engine hierarchy, projection, storage/network acknowledgement and hardware only where actually supported
output: PLATFORM_ADAPTER and attributed environment/calibration record
exception: Encoded screenshot dimensions do not establish logical viewport or mobile support
A desktop image does not prove touch or controller support
No CSS/pt/dp numbers or simulated insets become Roblox minima

recipes.title: Make source ownership and maintenance practical
recipes.authority_relationship: Operational synthesis/application of existing conditional contracts; no canonical rule change or automatic route promotion
recipes.when: When authorized UI source changes or refactoring are required.
process: Trace actual entry -> input -> domain validity/state -> view before editing; name To change X edit Y because Y owns Z
Separate real domain, presentation, tokens/assets, input and persistence/platform reasons to change; preserve good existing boundaries
Document contracts/dependency direction/lifecycle cleanup; refactor incrementally with characterization, repeated/failure/recovery parity tests
output: CHANGE_MAP, dependency/contract/lifecycle map, scoped diff and actual test outcomes
test: Protected behavior through real entry point
Dependency guard rejects forbidden edge where a direction contract exists
exception: No absent persistence/platform adapter or speculative manager is required
Do not split a small program merely to increase files/comments/layers
Refactoring and behavior changes remain separately scoped
